title: Li Ying Zah

page_data.en:
365
4/6/16.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
June 1st 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
It is reported that a man named Li Ying Zah 李英石
who is an old friend of Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang 馮國璋
is in Shanghai conferring with the rebel leaders, to
whom he has stated that Fong Kou Chang is prepared to
to do everything in his power to assist them.
It is reported that Chekiang merchants in Shanghai
are subscribing freely to the rebel funds. The
provisional government of Chekiang is hoping to get a
big consignment of munitions of war from Japan soon.
A high military officer named Kau Vung Lieu 高鳳樓
arrived at the Arsenal from Peking yesterday.
It is said that he has been sent here by Tuan Chi Jui
on a secret mission.

Your Obedient Servant,
William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

a.m. 1/6
Captain Superintendent of Police.
Entered and June 1.

4/6/16.
上海工部局。
1916年6月1日
（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生：

据报，一名叫李英石（Li Ying Zah）的男子，系冯国璋（Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang）之老友，现于上海与叛军首领会晤，并向他们表示，冯国璋准备竭尽全力予以协助。

据报，在沪浙江商人正慷慨捐助叛军经费。浙江临时政府希望不久能从日本获得大批军火。

一名叫高凤楼（Kau Vung Lieu）的高级军官昨日从北京抵达兵工厂。据说他是受段祺瑞（Tuan Chi Jui）派遣前来执行秘密任务。

您忠实的仆人，
威廉·阿姆斯特朗
首席侦探督察。

上午 1/6
警察总监。
已录入，6月1日。
